svg.text: POWER INPUT — USB-C PD motor input; the CH32X035 on Sheet 2 negotiates 15 V.
F1: 1.1 A resettable fuse. D_BLOCK: reverse-current barrier. D_VM_TVS: 16 V standoff TVS.
LOGIC POWER — U_3V3 regulates diode-ORed VM or DATA USB 5 V to 3.3 V.
U_3V3 powers the MCU, USB ESD bias, and TMC2209 VIO.
DATA USB-C — USB 2.0 programming/data and optional 5 V logic power.
Hold BOOT while connecting the port to enter ROM USB ISP.
U_USB_ESD — 5.25 V low-capacitance ESD protection; 27 ohm D+/D- series resistors.
U_MCU — CH32X035F8U6 USB-PD controller operating at 3.3 V.
Negotiates PD and drives STEP, DIR, ENN, UART, and STDBY.
SW_BOOT — Hold while connecting DATA USB-C to enter ROM USB ISP.
U_DRV — TMC2209-LA-T stepper driver; nominal VM 15 V and 0.60 A/phase maximum.
UART configures IRUN/IHOLD; STEP, DIR, ENN, and STDBY control motion.
MOTOR — 8HS15-0604S: 11 ohm, 5.5 mH; connector order A-, A+, B+, B-.
CURRENT SET — 0.33 ohm sense resistors and the VREF divider set the ceiling.
